info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Rideshare Ride API enables users to cancel previously booked rideshare services efficiently. This functionality is crucial for customers who need to modify their travel plans after securing a ride. By utilizing this endpoint, clients can ensure timely cancellations, which may help in recalibrating available ride options and optimizing driver assignments. Typical consumers include rideshare platform users, customer support teams, and fleet management systems looking to enhance operational workflows and customer satisfaction.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a previously booked ride. After cancellation, the ride will no longer be active and will be removed from the user's ongoing ride list.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to cancel a ride. Please ensure that the necessary ride identifiers and cancellation reasons are included.

201.description: The ride has been successfully canceled.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a ride operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the ride after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or message regarding the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation operation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_201.description: Response schema for the cancellation operation of a ride.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the cancellation was processed automatically.

Audit.description: Represents the audit information for a cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
